title: Age Calculator: how it works, formula and examples
excerpt: Age Calculator: Exact age in years, months and days. Learn how to use it, the formula behind it, a worked example and answers to common questions.
content:
The [Age Calculator](/age-calculator) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Exact age in years, months and days. Enter your date of birth and age on and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

Calculate your exact age from your date of birth, down to the day, along with total days lived and a countdown to your next birthday. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers. Related Date & Time tools include [Days Between Dates Calculator](/days-between-dates-calculator), [Date Calculator](/date-calculator) and [Time Calculator](/time-calculator).

## How to use the Age Calculator

Start by picking your date of birth, then picking your age on. The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults.

1. Pick your date of birth.
2. Pick your age on.
3. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
4. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

Count full years, then full months, then remaining days between the two dates, borrowing from the previous month when needed.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Age Calculator](/age-calculator) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. Born 15 January 2000, on 10 March 2026 you are 26 years, 1 month and 23 days old. Try the same figures in the [Age Calculator](/age-calculator) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves. ## What the result shows

With the default values (Date of birth: 1995-06-15, Age on: today), the [Age Calculator](/age-calculator) returns Age: 31 years 5 months 6 days, Total days: 11,482, Total weeks: 1,640, Next birthday in: 206 days. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. Change any value and every figure updates instantly. If you want to compare with a related calculation, the [Days Between Dates Calculator](/days-between-dates-calculator) is worth a look before you finish.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- Change the 'Age on' date to see your age on any future date.
- Leap years are handled automatically.

Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in.

## Frequently asked questions

### How do I calculate age in days?

Subtract the birth date from today; the calculator does this using real calendar dates. Try it with your own numbers in the [Age Calculator](/age-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### What if I was born on 29 February?

In non-leap years, legal birthdays are usually treated as 28 February or 1 March depending on the country. Try it with your own numbers in the [Age Calculator](/age-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### What formula does the Age Calculator use?

Count full years, then full months, then remaining days between the two dates, borrowing from the previous month when needed. You can see it in action in the [Age Calculator](/age-calculator) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.

### What do I need to use the Age Calculator?

Just Date of birth and Age on. Enter those values and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. If you are unsure about a value, try a rough figure first and then refine it — the result updates instantly.

### Is the Age Calculator free to use?

Yes. The Age Calculator is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up. There is no limit on how often you use it, nothing to install, and no account to create — open the [Age Calculator](/age-calculator) and start straight away.
